newsitem.title: NORWAY: Ocean Rig in Chinese rig-option deal.
newsitem.headline: Ocean Rig in Chinese rig-option deal.

text.p: Norway's Ocean Rig ASA said on Wednesday it had signed a memorandum of agreement with Dalian New Shipyard of China to draw up an option deal for ordering steel jackets.

Under the agreement, Ocean Rig will be given a 13-month option from June 30 to order one or two more steel jackets of Bingo 9000 design from Dalian at approximately $32 million a piece, a statement said.
Ocean Rig has previously commissioned Dalian to build two Bingo 9000 steel jackets for delivery in March and August 1998.
If ordered, the new jackets will be delivered in March and August 1999.
